cost: One open-addressing probe per lookup, O(1) expected at load factor <= 1/2, plus O(k) records; the acronym plural adds one probe. Blob compiled in (~20 MB); EN_LEXEXT read once.
description: The lexicon extension at run time: a second compiled blob of forms (tag, sources, lemma), lemma paradigms and acronym expansions, answering only for what the in-code dictionary lacks; the dictionary fingerprint and every trained model are untouched; EN_LEXEXT=0 turns it off.
forward: analyses(lower) = the form's records, or a synthetic NNPS for an -s plural of an acronym in capitals; known, tags, lemma(form, tag), form(lemma, tag), expansions(acronym, case-sensitive). hint(word, inside_cap) keeps acronym and two-capital records only for a word with two capitals, name-list-only and <= 3-letter proper records only for a capitalised word, and for a capitalised word inside a sentence only when a proper-noun record is left.
inverse: form(lemma, tag) recovers one form of the cell (several may share it); the written case is not recoverable from hint's tags.
Nothing is returned for: forms absent from the files (except acronym plurals), lower-case acronym keys, any lookup when EN_LEXEXT=0; hint is empty under the case gate.
limitations: Keys are lower case; case decisions live only in hint
No frequencies: records of one form are unordered
Acronyms read as NNP where EWT often writes NN with a lower-case lemma (ADHD, RFP)
state: Compiled lexext.bin and its layout constants; EN_LEXEXT OnceLock.
